cycles.title: Ten survivors under immediate attack
cycles.objective: Register exactly ten materially distinct hypotheses, attack each immediately, and bias the batch toward hypotheses that can refute existing JANUS mechanisms.
actions: Audited 2025-2026 primary sources for Cutting Planes, Stabbing Planes, Polynomial Calculus with extensions, and AC0[p]-Frege.
Recorded twenty attacks A057-A076, two per hypothesis.
Separated bounded coefficients from unrestricted Stabbing Planes and syntactic fan-in from semantic support.
Added four adversarial hypotheses whose success would destroy or sharply constrain H009, H010, H017, and related routes.
discoveries: Pure parity contradictions are poor candidates against H017 because Gaussian elimination is explicitly allowed.
Any Stabbing Planes separation from Cutting Planes must leave the bounded-coefficient SP* regime.
The most direct attack on H010 is not another direct degree lower bound but a support-normalization bridge to existing finite-field theorems.
Two pairs of new hypotheses are intentionally incompatible: H022 versus H023 and H024 versus H025.
cycles.claim_boundary: All ten entries remain OPEN only relative to the recorded attacks. No truth probability, novelty certification, P-versus-NP result, or simultaneous consistency claim is made.
next_cycle: Attempt a concrete counterfamily for H027 using expander Tseitin formulas with certified definitional extensions.
Formalize the exact recursive extension-PC verifier for H024-H025 and test whether H029 is false on simple global-support proof families.
Search for an unrestricted Stabbing Planes candidate outside finite-field systems and bounded-coefficient SP*.
Invite external review of the H026 tautologicity formulation against the exact ITCS 2026 DNF definition.
